# Total Fire Protection (TFP)

> > Total Fire Protection provides NFPA and OSHA compliant fire safety, suppression systems, and life safety services across NYC and the Tri-State area.

TFP specializes in fire sprinkler systems, suppression engineering, safety program development, and Joint Commission compliant healthcare solutions. Services include NFPA 25 certified installations, room integrity testing, emergency lighting, and comprehensive fire safety programs for commercial, healthcare, and industrial facilities.

## Key Topics

- NFPA 25 compliance
- OSHA training and standards
- Fire sprinkler systems (wet, dry, pre-action)
- Joint Commission healthcare compliance
- Emergency lighting and exit signage
- Photoluminescent egress markings
- Room integrity testing
- Fire suppression system engineering
- Life safety programs
- Code compliance (NFPA, OSHA)
- Commercial fire protection
- Kitchen suppression systems
- Fire extinguisher services
- NYC and Tri-State area coverage

## Fire Suppression Systems & Engineering

- [Fire Sprinkler & Suppression System Engineering Design & Installation](https://www.tfp1.com/fire-sprinkler-suppression-system-engineering-design-installation): NFPA 25 certified fire sprinkler & suppression system design/installation
- [Room Integrity Testing](https://www.tfp1.com/room-integrity-testing): Door fan testing for server rooms & IT spaces using gaseous agents

## Industries & Specialized Services

- [Industries We Serve](https://www.tfp1.com/industries): Fire protection services across industries in NYC & Tri-State area
- [Healthcare Fire & Life Safety Services](https://www.tfp1.com/fire-safety-for-healthcare): Joint Commission compliant fire safety for hospitals & medical facilities

## Safety Programs & Compliance

- [Fire & Life Safety Programs](https://www.tfp1.com/safety-program-development): Custom safety programs with OSHA training & NFPA compliance solutions
- [Safety Markings, Lighting & Signage](https://www.tfp1.com/safety-markings-lighting-signage): Safety markings, emergency lighting & OSHA/NFPA compliant signage services
